blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY – Hydropower firm SN Aboitiz Power-Benguet Inc. (SNAPBI) has committed P4 million to support the construction of the Itogon Super Health Center, supplementing the P20-million funding secured from the Department of Health (DOH) in 2025. The municipal government of Itogon and SNAPBI signed a memorandum of agreement on Oct. 12 at the municipal hall to formally utilize the donation to fund the facility’s masonry walls and roofing. READ: Aboitiz-backed SNAP eyes more green projects The donation will be charged against SNAPBI’s corporate social responsibility commitment for the Binga Battery Energy Storage System project, covering Phases 1 to 3.
